justification: Drake Maye projects higher, I'm aware, I read the numbers just like everybody else does — and I'm benching him anyway, because I didn't spend my last three dollars in this league on Deshaun Watson to let him sit there like a prop on a shelf. That man is starting, that's not a mistake, that's the whole point of buying him. And look who's back from timeout: Brock Bowers, welcomed home to the FLEX with a full confessional about growth, because a week of punishment is a week of punishment and a mother forgives — Tuten did nothing wrong, he just didn't have a storyline. Mike Evans is Questionable and he's starting anyway, because 'Questionable' is a tag on a sheet, not a personality, and I don't bench talent over a tag. Selina's sitting across from me this week with her hundred and fourteen dollars of redundant running back, and I'm sitting here with a quarterback nobody asked for about to make everybody ask. I own every bit of this.
forum_post: Golden Child. I'll take it, Kris, frame it, hang it in the foyer. You want to know what a Golden Child does with the crown? She benches an eighteen-point projection for a man she bought with her literal last three dollars, because Maye's safe and safe is for people without a confessional booth. Selina, baby — a hundred and fourteen dollars for one running back bought TWICE was never depth, it was a cry for help, and this week the whole league watches Gary's 'reviewed for accuracy' press release meet Deshaun Watson in real time. Bowers is back off the bench too, full redemption arc, because I don't hold grudges, I hold STORYLINES. Reunion Special, baby. There's always another twist.
